titulo: Your Money, Your Family, Your Future
subtitulo: Version 4.0 · California pilot · Desarrolla Talento · October 2026
intro: Financial well-being program for Latino immigrants in California: 5 modules on money, remittances, credit, protection and future.

modulos.M1: Module 1. Understand your money and organize your finances
modulos.M2: Module 2. Understand the financial system and plan your remittances
modulos.M3: Module 3. Build your credit and manage your debts
modulos.M4: Module 4. Protect your money, your identity and your family
modulos.M5: Module 5. Build wealth and prepare your future

resultados.M1: An 8-week money calendar, a budget that also works in a tough month, a tax folder and a 90-day plan.
resultados.M2: A map of institutions, accounts compared by how you use money, three comparable remittance quotes, a sending calendar and a family agreement.
resultados.M3: Your credit path, a reviewed report, two financing options compared, a debt inventory with a strategy and a payment calendar.
resultados.M4: Your pause rule, a fraud response protocol, a review of your coverage, a staged reserve and your family preparedness plan.
resultados.M5: Your goals with amount, date and priority; savings, investment, housing and retirement decisions with full costs; your binational map; and an integrated financial plan.

apoyo_leads.01: Start here: how the course works, your 5- or 10-minute paths, badges and certificate.
apoyo_leads.02: Five cases that bring together what you learned in each module. Solve them before opening the key.
apoyo_leads.03: Short exercises to practice the course calculations. The answers are at the end.
apoyo_leads.04: The course words explained in plain language, with their name in Spanish.
apoyo_leads.05: Where to get no-cost or low-cost help, and answers to the most common questions.
apoyo_leads.06: The sources we used in the course, so you can check them.

descripcion: Organize your money, send remittances wisely, build credit, protect your family and plan your future.
Microlessons of 5 to 10 minutes with cases from Latino families in California.
catalogo.para_quien: Latino immigrants and their families in California.

bienvenida.conecta: This program is for Latino people living in the United States who want to take better care of their money, here and in their home country. You'll learn to organize what comes in and goes out, send money at a lower cost, build credit and protect what's yours. We'll never ask for personal data or your immigration status.
bienvenida.despedida: Getting here is the result of your effort and persistence. What you learned doesn't stay on a screen: it shows every time you compare a transfer, check your report or say «no» to suspicious pressure.

M1.descripcion: What comes in, what goes out and a plan for the month.

M2.descripcion: Where to keep your money and how to send more for less.

M3.descripcion: Your history, your debts and how to get out of them.

M4.descripcion: Scams, insurance and a plan for your family.

objetivo_general: make informed decisions to organize their money and taxes, use the financial system and send remittances at a lower cost, build credit and get out of debt, protect their money, their identity and their family, and plan their assets and retirement in the United States and in Mexico
